'''Taul''' was a [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Gunthar system/Legends|Gunthar system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Taul was the site of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] trading post and training base used to train [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in severe conditions.

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] had largely ignored Taul and were unaware of the existence of a small Rebel base there. The Empire discovered the Rebel presence when one of the [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] sent out by the empire to find the Rebel base on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] was dispatched to Taul.

The base was [[Battle of Taul|destroyed]] by the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Dominator (Victory-class)|''Dominator'']].
